## Annotation

The page defines CSIL as “a self-directed option for eligible home support clients” who “receive funds directly from their local health authority to purchase their own home support services” and “become employers.” It lists eligibility criteria (including high physical care needs, physical disability, medical stability) and points to the CSIL Online Workbook and the Continuing Care Fees Regulation.

This archive uses the page as a citable official description of the **current** program, not as evidence of 1993–95 design.
